target_customer: Private equity firms and executive search firms serving PE
problem: PE firms struggle to source proprietary deals and to find warm paths and backchannel references into target companies and executives.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription (inferred from product positioning; pricing not found)
product_category: Relationship intelligence and executive research for private equity

founders.name: Nicholas Manske
education: INSEAD (2017, executive program, per YC page)
previous_startups: Alariss Global (executive search software, grew to 37 employees per YC page)

technical_complexity.rationale: Mapping professional relationships and joining them with private company data needs data ingestion and entity resolution, but is standard engineering for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: YC page claims 1.5M executive profiles and 30M mapped relationships, but data of this kind can be assembled by others; claims are unverified.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Relationship intelligence CRMs exist for private capital today; no source shows what they did about Verata.

market_need_then: PE firms compete for proprietary deal flow and rely on personal networks for diligence; no dated 2023 source on spend was found.

branding.domain_note: Operates at veratainsight.com; legal entity AiFlow, Inc. doing business as Verata (company site).

identity.voice_and_tone: Professional, partner-level positioning: 'Partner-level market knowledge. Built for PE talent.'

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself found.

pivots.from: Relationship intelligence for investor deal sourcing
pivots.to: Executive intelligence platform for PE talent and executive search (current site positioning)

outcome_analysis: Verata is a two person company that remains active with no public funding announcement, customer names or exit. Its current site has moved toward executive intelligence for PE talent teams, building on the founders' prior executive search software companies. There is too little sourced evidence to say whether it is stalling or growing.
notes: Funding: PitchBook (via search snippet) lists $500K with Hunt Scanlon Ventures and Y Combinator; single aggregator, unverified, not recorded as a round. PitchBook and the YC page list founded 2025 despite the W23 batch, so founded_year is null. Do not confuse with Verata Health (acquired by Olive in 2020). No competitor list dated near the batch was found; searches returned only 2025 to 2026 vendor comparison pages, which are not valid as of founding. Brand name origin not found.
